run_preprocess_mewsli: run the script to convert MEWSLI-9 dataset to KILT JSONL format for entity linking
run_wikidata_mapping_load: run the script to load Wikipedia title, redirect, and alias to Wikidata ID mappings from pickle files
run_kilt_dataset_generation: run the script to generate KILT-format JSONL files with mention context and Wikidata answers per language
run_mewsli_docs_mentions_merge: run the script to merge MEWSLI docs and mentions TSV files by docid for entity linking preprocessing
run_get_wikidata_ids: run the script to extract Wikidata IDs from Wikipedia URLs using title, redirect, and alias lookup tables
